method.frontier_basis: Current compiled reference-line links and explicit crossing_contexts only. This queue does not create additional pairs from country co-occurrence. These reference lines are not approved phase geometry or closure extents.
method.record_assignment: Each included record has one ledger row. A sole bilateral context is primary only if there are no unresolved links; multiple contexts remain scope-review work.
method.text_lead_unit: Whole workbook crossing field, verbatim. One field can name multiple locations or no individually identifiable facility.
method.text_screen_basis: Current workbook Locations rows: verified primary-source marker or medium text/name precision. Low-precision and narrative scope remain review leads without named-location priority. This never establishes a facility identity or phase applicability.
method.rationale_basis: Current replacement-workbook categories, subcategories and coding status; overlapping categories are retained without a primary motive.
priority_order: single-frontier specific text excluding explicit rail/ferry/pedestrian-only text
method.transport_screen: Text-only triage; mixed and unknown modes require review. No facility, source association or event link is accepted automatically.
method.regional_batch_basis: Most frequent workbook region among contextual records; alphabetical tie-break.
method.coverage: Historical extraction and reference-review status are independent and never establish all-crossing completeness or validate links to the replacement workbook.
